query: How will we design field validation and ground-truthing (sample locations, timing, travel-time measurement protocol, instruments) to evaluate modeled travel times and barrier mapping?

response.query: How will we design field validation and ground-truthing (sample locations, timing, travel-time measurement protocol, instruments) to evaluate modeled travel times and barrier mapping?
response.answer: Design field validation with strategically selected sample locations, timing aligned with peak travel times, and use GPS and stopwatches for precise travel-time measurement. Instruments include handheld GPS devices and portable data loggers.
